title: 호텔 프런트에서: 체크인은 몇 시부터라고 했어요?
objective: Check in, ask about check-out, and report what you heard with -(이)라고 / -ㄴ다고 / -다고.
summary: A hotel front-desk talk about early check-in and late check-out.
setting: The front desk of a city hotel, early in the afternoon. Michael arrives before the check-in time.

task.title: Quote, choose, and complete
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to do each task, and use the quote forms -(이)라고 / -ㄴ다고 / -는다고 / -다고 where asked.

words.exampleMeaning: My flight was late, so I checked in at 10 p.m.

words.meaning: to check out (leave the hotel and return the key)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm going to check out early tomorrow morning.

words.meaning: key card (for a hotel room door)
words.exampleMeaning: I left my key card in the room.

words.example: 한 사람이 더 자면 추가 요금이 있어요?
words.exampleMeaning: Is there an extra charge if one more person stays?

dialogue.korean: 마이클 브라운 이름으로 예약했어요. 체크인이 3시부터라고 들었는데, 지금 들어갈 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: I have a reservation under Michael Brown. I heard that check-in starts at 3. Can I go in now?

dialogue.korean: 잠시만요. 네, 객실이 준비돼 있어서 지금 바로 들어가실 수 있습니다. 여권 좀 보여 주시겠어요?
dialogue.meaning: One moment. Yes, your room is ready, so you can go in right now. Could you show me your passport?
Thank you. What time is check-out?

dialogue.korean: 오전 11시까지입니다. 체크아웃하신 후에 짐은 프런트에 맡기셔도 됩니다.
dialogue.meaning: By 11 a.m. After you check out, you can leave your luggage at the front desk.

dialogue.korean: 잘됐네요. 친구가 늦게 체크아웃해도 된다고 했는데, 가능해요?
dialogue.meaning: Great. My friend said I could check out late. Is that possible?

dialogue.korean: 네, 전날까지 프런트에 말씀해 주세요. 추가 요금이 있을 수 있습니다.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, please tell the front desk by the day before. There may be an extra charge.

exercises: Change the word in brackets into a quote (noun → -(이)라고, verb → -ㄴ다고/-는다고, adjective → -다고): ① 직원이 수영장은 밤 9시에 ____ 했어요. (닫다) ② 직원이 엘리베이터가 지금 ____ 했어요. (고장이다) ③ 친구가 이 호텔 침대가 아주 ____ 했어요. (편하다)
Choose the right word: ① 오후 1시인데 방에 일찍 들어가고 싶어요. → (체크인 / 체크아웃)을 일찍 할 수 있어요? ② 방에서 담배를 피우면 안 돼요. → 이 객실은 (금연 / 조식)이에요. ③ 한 사람이 더 자요. → (추가 요금 / 카드 키)을/를 내야 해요?
Answer in English based on the dialogue: ① Why can Michael go to his room before 3 o'clock? ② By when should he ask about a late check-out?
Complete the sentence to tell the staff that you heard you can see the sea from the room: 방에서 바다가 ____ 들었는데요. (보이다)
answers: ① 닫는다고 ② 고장이라고 ③ 편하다고
① 체크인 ② 금연 ③ 추가 요금
① Because his room is already ready. ② By the day before check-out (he should tell the front desk the day before).
